name: Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis
description: Streamline makes the world's largest icon, illustration, emoji and graphic element sets. Each massive set is refined by an in-house team of 8 icon designers for over 16 years. The free version of Streamline includes 100,000+ icons and 21,000+ elements, available in both SVG and PNG formats. The pro version of Streamline has larger sets with ~400,000 graphic assets, available as a subscription or a one-time purchase.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://public-api.streamlinehq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis provides these MCP tools: download_asset, download_multiple_assets, find_sets_by_name, get_all_families, get_all_sets_from_family, get_family_extra_details, get_icon_by_hash, search_assets, and search_sets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis?

acceptedAnswer.text: Streamline Icons, Illustrations, Emojis is developed by Streamline Design. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
